name: Bulkhead + fallback
description: The same design as "A slow dependency takes down the whole service", with a bulkhead (at most 4 concurrent calls per instance) and a fallback (a default recommendation list on failure) on the connection from the API to the recommendation service. When recommendations become slow, at most 4 slots wait; the other calls get the fallback at once: no request fails, and about 80% of the requests get a degraded response. One of the two alone is not enough: with only the fallback, the slots still fill up; with only the bulkhead, the rejected calls make requests fail.
